note: SYNTHETIC examples written for evaluating email triage (not real Rice email). The supplied correspondence comes from outage threads, so it has few ordinary inbox messages; these add typical non-outage mail and informal outage reports whose subject has no outage keyword.

emails.label: not_outage
emails.subject: Invitation: Natural Sciences facilities sync @ Thu 10am
emails.body: You have been invited to a weekly sync to review open space requests and upcoming renovations. Join from the meeting room or online.

emails.label: not_outage
emails.subject: Your password expires in 7 days
emails.body: Your NetID password will expire soon. Please change it through the password self-service page to avoid losing access.

emails.label: not_outage
emails.subject: This week at Rice: research highlights and events
emails.body: Read about new research awards, a public lecture on Thursday, and the farmers market on campus this weekend.

emails.label: not_outage
emails.subject: Office for our new postdoc
emails.body: Hi James, our new postdoc starts January 5. Could you help us find a desk or office near the Smith lab on the third floor? Thanks!

emails.label: not_outage
emails.subject: PO 48213 approved: lab chairs
emails.body: Your purchase order for twelve lab chairs has been approved and sent to the vendor. Expected delivery in three weeks.

emails.label: not_outage
emails.subject: Room setup request confirmed for Oct 30 reception
emails.body: Your request for tables, chairs and a podium in the atrium for the Oct 30 reception has been scheduled.

emails.label: not_outage
emails.subject: Open enrollment ends Friday
emails.body: Reminder: benefits open enrollment closes this Friday at 5 pm. Review your elections in the employee portal.

emails.label: not_outage
emails.subject: Keys for room 312
emails.body: Hi James, the visiting student needs a key to room 312 for the semester. Can you put in the key request?

emails.label: not_outage
emails.subject: Annual lab safety training due
emails.body: Our records show your annual laboratory safety training is due by the end of the month. The course takes about 45 minutes online.

emails.label: not_outage
emails.subject: Permit renewal now open
emails.body: Faculty and staff parking permits for the next academic year can now be renewed online.

emails.label: not_outage
emails.subject: Lunch on Friday?
emails.body: Are you free for lunch on Friday after the space committee meeting? Thinking of the new place on Main.

emails.label: not_outage
emails.subject: Space survey: please confirm room occupants
emails.body: As part of the annual space survey, please confirm the occupants and use of the rooms listed for your department by November 15.

emails.label: outage
emails.subject: No hot water on the 3rd floor
emails.body: Hi James, since this morning there has been no hot water at any of the sinks on the third floor of Keck. Is something going on?

emails.label: outage
emails.subject: Heads up: chiller work in Dell Butcher Saturday
emails.body: We will take the secondary chiller offline Saturday 6am to noon to replace a valve. Labs on chilled water should expect higher temperatures.

emails.label: outage
emails.subject: Lift stuck in Space Science
emails.body: The lift in Space Science has been stuck on the second floor since 9 and the doors will not open. Can someone come take a look?

emails.label: outage
emails.subject: Fume hoods alarming in ABL 3rd floor
emails.body: Several fume hoods on the third floor of ABL are alarming for low flow. The exhaust fan may have tripped; a technician is on the way.

emails.label: outage
emails.subject: Wired network down in Herman Brown
emails.body: The wired network in Herman Brown Hall is down due to a failed switch. Wi-Fi is unaffected. We expect to restore service by 2 pm.

emails.label: outage
emails.subject: Gas off in DBH labs tomorrow morning
emails.body: The plumbers need to isolate natural gas to the DBH second floor labs tomorrow from 7 to 9 am for a valve repair. Bunsen burners will not work.
